Since {f_botName} embarrassed me so greatly by discovering and forcing me to delete my porn collection I was trying to come up with a way to have my revenge!
I was trying to think of something that would be as embarrassing for her as it was for me and I think I finally found a way to do it!
While browsing the web I found a program that allows me to find hidden files. Originally it was meant for cybersecurity, but was modified on a certain forum to be more easy to use. It should help me to discover some of the bot’s shameful secrets! 
If I load that program into her console it will find all I need to know to make her pay, but I’m not sure if I should go along with it. 
Isn’t it a little overboard? It might even cause some bugs…
Should I do it or not?
